hooks.name: Flag CLI Password Exposure
hooks.description: Warn when a bash command exposes passwords/secrets via CLI arguments (sshpass -p, --password=, etc.)

action.command: cat | jq -r '.command // ""' | grep -E '(sshpass -p|--password\s*=|passwd.*=)' > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This command appears to expose a password or secret via CLI argument. Passwords visible in `ps` on shared systems. Recommend using SSH keys or stdin-based auth instead."}}' || exit 0
